description.value:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Effect The naval crew draws and fires their flintlock pistols in a @Template[type:burst|distance:10] within 40 feet, dealing @Damage[7d4[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:23|basic|options:area-effect] save). Each creature uses the weaker of its resistance or immunity to piercing or bludgeoning damage, and any that critically fails its save takes an additional @Damage[10[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage after doubling. When the naval crew is reduced to 2 or fewer segments, this area decreases to a @Template[type:burst|distance:5].
